In China, people have noodles with soups. They also eat fried noodles with vegetables and meat.
Some noodles are called glass noodles because of their appearance when cooked. Chinese people usually
eat noodles with chopsticks. However, Westerners are used to having noodles with a fork. For example,
people in Italy eat noodles with a fork and a spoon, and they call noodles spaghetti! Spaghetti is usually
eaten with meat or tomato sauce. In Germany, people also use a fork to have noodles, either with sauce or
with cheese.
